en: Huh? What's up, Shuichi?

inviting you out myself.

the main character in an anime.

invite me somewhere?

Even if you spent time with me, 
it's plain to see you'd be bored.

I'm pretty sure the second season of 
my favorite anime is airing right now...
Spend time together
